summary: Full auth (JWT email+password) verification + regression on all prior features. Backend: 83/83 pytest tests pass (49 new auth tests in test_auth.py + 34 pre-existing regression tests updated to send Bearer token). Verified login/me/logout/change-password, 401 gating of every /api route (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE incl. import/parse-csv and import/confirm), password rotation + restore, and idempotent admin seed across a real backend restart (rotated password survived restart, .env password rejected, exactly 1 user doc, no duplicates). Frontend: all 8 requested auth flows pass on the preview URL (ProtectedRoute redirect, /login render + testids, Spanish error on wrong password, successful login + 'Sesión iniciada' toast + KPIs + 4 recharts + sidebar email, logout desktop & mobile with 'Sesión cerrada', session persistence on reload, Seguridad tab change-password happy path + 3 error paths, axios 401 interceptor clearing token and redirecting). Seeded password <ADMIN_PASSWORD> confirmed restored and working at the end (login=200, .env untouched).

minor.issue: No rate limiting / lockout on failed logins — single-user app is open to unthrottled brute force. Consider a simple per-IP/email attempt counter.

Password rotation does not invalidate previously issued JWTs (no token_version / password_updated_at claim check). A stolen 30-day token keeps working after a password change. Verified: token minted before rotation still authenticated.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid nav-* is duplicated (desktop sidebar + mobile drawer render the same testid), so a plain locator resolves to 2 elements and clicks the hidden one. Suggest suffixing the drawer ones (e.g. nav-gastos-mobile).

issues: Uses the native browser <input type="month"> picker (2026-09) instead of the shadcn calendar component — inconsistent with the rest of the UI (pre-existing, not auth-related)

Default month is the current month which has no seeded data, so all KPIs read 0,00 € and the donut shows 'Sin gastos en este periodo' — first impression looks empty. Consider defaulting to the latest month with data.

action_items: Optional: suffix duplicated nav-* data-testids in the mobile drawer of MainLayout.js
Optional hardening: invalidate old JWTs on password change (store password_updated_at in the token and compare in get_current_user)
Optional hardening: add login rate limiting
Optional UX: default Dashboard month to the most recent month with data instead of the current month
Code quality: /app/backend/server.py is 1154 lines — split into routers/auth.py, routers/dashboard.py, routers/import.py, models.py
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds the 700-line guideline (1154 lines); auth, models, import parsing and dashboard aggregations should be separate modules.
get_current_user correctly projects out _id and password_hash; /auth/login and /auth/me leak neither — good.
seed_admin is correctly idempotent (find_one then insert only if missing) and a unique index on users.email is created on startup — verified by a live restart test.
auth.js interceptor guards with getToken() before clearing/redirecting, so a 401 from /auth/login itself does not trigger a redirect loop — correct.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test resources (TEST_ prefixed accounts/cards/categories/rules) created and torn down by fixtures. Password was rotated twice (API test + UI test + restart test) and restored to <ADMIN_PASSWORD> each time; final verification login returned 200.
test_credentials: <ADMIN_EMAIL> / <ADMIN_PASSWORD> — verified working and restored; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is accurate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py now exposes credentials/auth_token/get_token helpers reading /app/memory/test_credentials.md; backend_test.py's `sess` fixture is authenticated. test_auth.py covers login/me/logout/change-password + 401 gating of all routes. manual_seed_idempotency.py is a standalone script (restarts backend) — run it only deliberately, it restores the password itself. Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest . -q -p no:randomly.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Two earlier test-script failures were my own artifacts: (1) /api/dashboard/monthly-summary requires a `year` query param (422 without it) — fixed the test; (2) the 401-interceptor check hit the duplicated nav-* testid and clicked a hidden mobile-drawer element — fixed with a :visible locator, after which the interceptor cleared the token and redirected to /login as designed.
